dataset_name: Grid-Sentinel / Grid-India National SCADA Telemetry Snapshot
source_repository: Grid-India (POSOCO) National Load Despatch Centre (NLDC) / Grid-Sentinel Research Archive
license_provenance: Authentic public grid telemetry snapshot curated for chronological ML benchmarking; raw observations preserved without synthetic interpolation.
prospective_validation_status: PROSPECTIVE VALIDATION BLOCKED — NEW AUTHENTIC DATA REQUIRED

data_dictionary.description: 15-minute SCADA interval timestamp in Indian Standard Time (UTC+05:30).
National electricity demand met in Megawatts. Target variable at t + 16 intervals (+4 hours).
Scheduled generation aggregate. NOT measured physical delivered supply; excluded from physical deficit/surplus accounting.
Strictly causal backward-looking demand lags (4, 16, and 96 intervals prior to issue time).
4-observation trailing mean ending at forecast issue timestamp t.
Trigonometric encodings of issue time-of-day and day-of-week.
Nationwide utility battery state-of-charge is not present in the 164-column SCADA snapshot. Available only as explicit user-entered simulation assumptions.
Reconciled delivered generation + net cross-border imports/exports + transmission losses required for physical imbalance calculation.
